Engineering Design Review - Feature Flags

Author: John Taylor | Reviewers: John Smith, Alice Williams, Jane Doe, Bob Johnson
Date: 2026-07-07 | Status: Monitoring

Context:
No centralized audit trail

Proposed Design:
New payment abstraction
Provider-agnostic interface
Webhook retry with backoff

Alternatives Considered:
Polling with Redis
SSE instead of WebSocket
Third-party notification service

Trade-offs:
Complexity vs real-time
Cost vs latency
Build vs buy

Security Considerations:
Encrypt PII in events
Validate webhook signatures
Rate limit per tenant

Testing Strategy:
Unit: 80% coverage
Integration: contract tests
Load: 2x peak traffic
Chaos: dependency failure

Rollout Plan:
Canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%
Feature flag per tenant
Rollback in <2min

Open Questions:
Event ordering guarantees?
Schema evolution strategy?
Cross-region replication?
